current_examples: L/S/M/Y/fixed-anchors all previously examined development; no blind confirmation this turn
physical_configuration_unknowns: retain null and reason; do not treat administrative labels as verified hardware revisions
grouping: one physical device and thermal configuration per model/registry; duplicate field/modeling actual_run_id is one process
temporal_order_for_future_use: earlier complete approved runs for calibration; later whole processes reserved for confirmation; freeze roles and checksums before fit
same_run_business_sessions: not implemented as automatic v1 splitting; require preregistered real session boundaries and explicit causal history handling before use; never alias adjacent seconds as independent runs

boundary_guard.rule: labels never cross an actual-run/model/config/clock boundary; remove any label extending beyond a reserved partition. Do not fill missing 90s by deleting valid 45s labels

initialization: past observations at each origin only; same 60s budget and E policy for every model; no future temperature or validation-wide state fitting
data_ingest: TTO-G2-MODELING-DATA-v1 from original quality-engine evidence and unchanged R2 data_views; no vendor schema or TTL guessing
role_changes: if new reserved data is inspected for threshold/window/model selection, record as development; do not automatically add a fresh experiment to obtain a pass
insufficient_processes: candidate generation may proceed from approved informative calibration data, but output future_confirmation_available=false; do not fabricate a validation partition
metrics: A-long/A-roll separate from past-only B-HOLD and B-RELAX30; 15/45/90 independently; 45 primary; common origins/labels plus full accepted-TJ denominator, background/dynamic strata and underprediction tails
candidate_decisions: insufficient/numerically_incomplete/not_better/development_tradeoff/manual_observation_candidate. Report average and tails; no automatic activation
selection: explicit reason and confirmation, retained rollback, next new observation session only; existing session model/state never hot switched
